name: Hijiri Yukari
source: Joins in the earth route. Master of the holy type guardian Nolt. Former member of the JSDF and the team brains. Logical to a fault and is capable of making difficult decisions if it's for the good of the group. She often butts heads with Yuuko due to their contrasting personalities, but cares for her deeply despite that.
